name: stackoverflow_qa
description: Short programming question titles (StackOverflow 20-class style). Goal: questions about the SAME technology collapse to a heavily overlapping KG anchored on the canonical technology entity. The class is a single technology tag (spring, hibernate, scala, oracle, linq).
canonicalization_hints: Every question has a primary technology anchor — emit (Question, about_technology, <Canonical_Tech>). Canonicalize names: 'Spring MVC'/'Spring Security'/'Spring 2.5' all carry the anchor Spring (plus the specific module as its own Technology when named).
Canonicalize: LINQ, Hibernate, Spring, Scala, Oracle, Entity_Framework, JDBC, Active_Directory, SQL, DataSet, DataTable, EHCache.
Capture the operation/concept the question is about: performs_operation (Query, Join, Paging, Authentication, Logging, Validation, Type_Conversion) and integrates_with for cross-technology questions.
The asker's framing ('How do I', 'Best way to', 'Beginners guide') is a speech act — drop it. Use a single 'Question' subject node as the anchor.
If a title is off-topic vs its tag, extract what it actually asks — do not force the tag.

inline_examples.text: How do I fill a DataSet or a DataTable from a LINQ query resultset?
How do you authenticate against an Active Directory server using Spring Security?
